info.name: Expense Capture (Task A)
info.description:
Receipt upload, taxes as their own records, and auto-itemize.

Run the folders in order, or use Collection Runner on the whole collection: later requests reuse ids captured by earlier ones via collection variables.

Start the service first:
  mvn spring-boot:run -Dspring-boot.run.arguments=--server.port=8099

Then set baseUrl if you are not on 8099. OCR is stubbed; no API key is needed.
